name: Punch Out Of Prison
desc:
Locked in a cell with your friends? Punch your way out!

🆕 UPDATE: CHAPTER 3 - THE SEWERS! Fight the rat bosses, beat THE RAT KING for the key, clear the junk and ride the wave to freedom.

👊 Break the prison walls cube by cube in first person, with 13 different hole shapes
💰 Sell the rubble at the crusher and buy upgrades: harder punches, bigger holes, a bigger backpack and helpers
🔎 FIND MATCH: team up with up to 5 players, even from other lobbies
⚔️ DUELS: fight in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3
🔦 3 chapters to escape on Easy, Normal, Hard and INSANE
💎 Earn gems for every escape and unlock gloves, hit effects, classes and emotes
🎁 Open crates for skins and limited gloves, and trade with other players
💪 Train at THE GYM for permanent upgrades
🏆 Hall of Fame: fastest times for every chapter, most escapes, blocks and playtime
💡 Vote for the best ideas on the IDEAS board

Use code RELEASE for free gems!

llm.loop: punch prison walls cube by cube -> sell rubble at the crusher -> buy harder punches, bigger holes, backpack, helpers -> escape chapters -> earn gems for gloves and cosmetics
llm.objectives: escape all 3 chapters on increasing difficulties and set fastest times
llm.progression: punch/backpack upgrades, gym permanent upgrades, chapters and difficulties, gems, gloves, classes, Hall of Fame
llm.instructions: punch your way out, sell rubble for upgrades, team up with up to 5 players, fight bosses; use code RELEASE
unique: mining-sim loop framed as a co-op prison break with chapters, bosses and duels
